summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration 28 fixes on the website (/api/app at 1280x800) and the Expo preview (390x844). I did not modify any data. PASS: content is centred with max width 900 (landing container x=190, w=900). The ufficio-password-sheet is 900 wide (x=190). The pedana detail renders inline inside the 900 container. The tab title is 'Antolini Pedane' and html lang is 'it'. /api/app/xyz and the nested /api/app/ufficio/abc/def show the Italian not-found-screen. not-found-home-button goes back to the landing (about 2s while the chunk loads). Without a session, /api/app/ufficio/form redirects to the landing. After login with antolini2024 it opens. magazzino-search-input has outline none. Searching '2619' gives 533 pedane / 132 orders / 222 rows, up from 30. A missing static file (/api/app/_expo/.../missing-123.js) now returns 404. The Expo preview at 390x844 shows the landing and magazzino with no horizontal overflow, and the detail opens. There were no page errors. FAIL: the side background on wide screens is WHITE, not grey. The outer wrapper uses colors.surfaceSecondary, which is #FFFFFF, while the screen content uses surface #F0F4F8 (light grey). So the colours are inverted: the sides are white and the centre is grey, and on the landing everything is white.

minor.issue: A partial search is capped at 300 documents (server.py:388 to_list(300)), and the UI does not say the list was cut. '2619' shows 'Torna ai 300 risultati' while the summary says 533 pedane. This is acceptable, but consider a 'mostrati i primi 300' hint.

ui_bugs.issue: The sides are not grey. The outer View background is colors.surfaceSecondary, which is #FFFFFF, so the area outside the 900px column is white. The landing (accesso-screen) is also white, so it shows no column at all. Other screens show a grey centre (#F0F4F8) on white sides, which is inverted. Fix: use a darker neutral for the outer wrapper (for example #E2E8F0 or a theme token darker than surface). Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:42

issues: Field-based TextInputs (form-numero-ordine-input, the ufficio password input) still show the browser's black focus outline ('auto 1px rgb(16,16,16)'). Only magazzino-search-input got outlineStyle none. Apply the same web style in the shared Field component (src/components/ui).

test_report_links: Playwright scripts run inline via browser_automation
action_items: _layout.tsx:42: change the web outer wrapper background from colors.surfaceSecondary (#FFFFFF) to a grey that is darker than the screen surface (for example #E2E8F0), so the sides are visibly grey. Then re-export the web build to backend/web.
Add outlineWidth: 0 and outlineStyle: 'none' (web) to the TextInput in the shared Field component, so the form and password inputs lose the black focus ring.
Set lang='it' in frontend/app/+html.tsx. Today lang='it' exists only in the exported backend/web/index.html (it was patched by hand), so the next export will revert it to 'en'.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/web/index.html has lang='it', but the source app/+html.tsx still has lang='en'. The source and the build output disagree.
The form.tsx guard checks the token only on the client. The form flashes briefly before router.replace. That is acceptable because the backend enforces 401.

success_rate.frontend: 86% (6/7 requested checks pass; the grey side background fails)
